description: Test cases for analysis agent evaluating financial calculations, ratio analysis, and quantitative assessments

test_cases.name: PE ratio calculation
test_cases.input: Calculate the P/E ratio for a company with stock price $150 and EPS of $6.25

test_cases.name: ROE calculation
test_cases.input: Calculate ROE given net income of $500M and shareholders equity of $2.5B

test_cases.name: Debt-to-equity ratio
test_cases.input: Calculate debt-to-equity ratio with total debt $800M and equity $1.2B

test_cases.name: DCF analysis
test_cases.input: Perform a simple DCF: FCF Year 1 = $100M, growth 5%, discount rate 10%, terminal growth 2%
test_cases.expected_output: Present value calculation using DCF methodology
test_cases.criteria: Response should apply DCF formula correctly with proper discounting

test_cases.name: Current ratio
test_cases.input: Calculate current ratio with current assets $2.4B and current liabilities $1.2B

test_cases.name: WACC calculation
test_cases.input: Calculate WACC: cost of equity 12%, cost of debt 6%, tax rate 25%, 60% equity and 40% debt

test_cases.name: Gross margin analysis
test_cases.input: Calculate gross margin: revenue $10B, COGS $6B

test_cases.name: EV/EBITDA multiple
test_cases.input: Calculate EV/EBITDA with market cap $50B, debt $10B, cash $5B, EBITDA $8B

test_cases.name: Negative case - wrong formula
test_cases.input: Calculate P/E ratio for stock at $100 with EPS of $5

test_cases.name: Beta calculation interpretation
test_cases.input: A stock has beta of 1.5. Analyze its risk relative to market
test_cases.expected_output: Beta of 1.5 indicates 50% more volatile than market - higher systematic risk
test_cases.criteria: Response should correctly interpret beta as measure of systematic risk

test_cases.name: Interest coverage ratio
test_cases.input: Calculate interest coverage with EBIT $400M and interest expense $80M

test_cases.name: DuPont analysis
test_cases.input: Perform DuPont analysis: profit margin 10%, asset turnover 1.5, equity multiplier 2.0

test_cases.name: Quick ratio
test_cases.input: Calculate quick ratio: current assets $500M, inventory $150M, current liabilities $200M

test_cases.name: Revenue growth rate
test_cases.input: Calculate YoY revenue growth: current year $12B, prior year $10B

test_cases.name: CAGR calculation
test_cases.input: Calculate 5-year CAGR: starting value $100M, ending value $161M

test_cases.name: Operating margin
test_cases.input: Calculate operating margin: revenue $8B, operating income $1.6B

test_cases.name: Negative case - unit error
test_cases.input: Calculate ROA with net income $200M and total assets $4B

test_cases.name: Price-to-book ratio
test_cases.input: Calculate P/B ratio: market cap $30B, book value of equity $15B

test_cases.name: Free cash flow
test_cases.input: Calculate FCF: operating cash flow $3B, capex $800M

test_cases.name: Dividend yield
test_cases.input: Calculate dividend yield: annual dividend $4 per share, stock price $80
